source_title: To What Extent Are Tariffs Offset By Exchange Rates?
methodology: calibrated two-country model + high-frequency event study of 2018-19 tariff announcements
extraction_note: claim_text 是从英文原文读出的中文转述；evidence_span 是论文原句，可逐字核对。方向判定由人工做出，不是规则抽取。

claims.claim_text: 美国对中国出口加征关税后，人民币对美元贬值；该效应在各期限上统计显著且较为持续。
claims.evidence_span: the renminbi depreciates against the dollar in response to an increase in US tariffs on Chinese exports
claims.policy_condition: 2018-19 年关税战期间，人民币汇率由中间价管理

claims.claim_text: 2018-19 年的关税约解释美元有效升值的五分之一、人民币有效贬值的三分之二——关税对人民币的冲击远大于对美元的冲击。
claims.evidence_span: tariffs explained at most one fifth of the dollar effective appreciation but around two thirds of the renminbi effective depreciation observed in 2018-19
